00197 inline Ran088::Ran088(unsigned long seed)
00198 {       
00199     int* seedPtr = 0;
00200     
00201     if(seed == 0)
00202     {
00203         // use the addess of an allocated pointer as the seed
00204         seedPtr = new int;
00205         seed = (unsigned long)seedPtr;
00206         seed *= 39458953U;
00207         seed += 18479161U;
00208     }
00209     
00210     // initialize seeds using the given seed value taking care of
00211     // the requirements. The constants below are arbitrary otherwise
00212     s1 = 1243598713U ^ seed; if (s1 <  2) s1 = 1243598713U;
00213     s2 = 3093459404U ^ seed; if (s2 <  8) s2 = 3093459404U;
00214     s3 = 1821928721U ^ seed; if (s3 < 16) s3 = 1821928721U; 
00215     
00216     delete seedPtr;
00217 }

00250 inline unsigned long Ran088::next()
00251 {
00252     // generate a random 32 bit number
00253     s1 = ((s1 &  -2) << 12) ^ (((s1 << 13) ^  s1) >> 19);
00254     s2 = ((s2 &  -8) <<  4) ^ (((s2 <<  2) ^  s2) >> 25);
00255     s3 = ((s3 & -16) << 17) ^ (((s3 <<  3) ^  s3) >> 11);
00256     return s1 ^ s2 ^ s3;
00257 }

00259 inline double Ran088::nextDouble()
00260 {
00261     // return a double from 0.0 to 0.999...
00262 #if BYTE_ORDER == BIG_ENDIAN
00263     union { struct { unsigned long hi, lo; } i; double f; } du;
00264 #else
00265     union { struct { unsigned long lo, hi; } i; double f; } du;
00266 #endif
00267     du.i.hi = 0x41300000; 
00268     du.i.lo = next();
00269     return du.f - 1048576.;
00270 }
00271 
00272 inline float Ran088::nextFloat()
00273 {
00274     // return a float from 0.0 to 0.999...
00275     union { unsigned long i; float f; } u;      // union for floating point conversion of result
00276     u.i = 0x3F800000 | (next() >> 9);
00277     return u.f - 1.f;
00278 }
00279

00284     u.i = 0x3F800000 | (next() >> 9);
00285     return u.f;
00286 }

00296 inline float Ran088::nextFloat8()

00304 inline float Ran088::coin()
00305 {
00306     // only return one of the two values -1.0 or +1.0
00307     union { unsigned long i; float f; } u;      // union for floating point conversion of result
00308     u.i = 0x3F800000 | (0x80000000 & next());
00309     return u.f;
00310 }

00312 inline long Ran088::nextLong(long scale)

00318 inline long Ran088::nextBiLong(long scale)
00319 {
00320     // return a int from -scale to +scale
00321     return (long)std::floor((2. * scale + 1.) * nextDouble() - scale);
00322 }

00352 inline double Ran088::nextExpRandRange(double lo, double hi)
00353 {
00354     return lo * std::exp(std::log(hi / lo) * nextDouble());

00357 inline double Ran088::nextExpRand(double scale)
00358 {
00359     double z;
00360     while ((z = nextDouble()) == 0.0) {}
00361     return -std::log(z) * scale;

00373 inline double Ran088::nextGaussianApprox(double scale)
00374 {
00375     // larry polansky's poor man's gaussian generator
00376     return (nextDouble() + nextDouble() + nextDouble() - 1.5) * 0.666666667 * scale;
00377 }

00379 inline unsigned long Ran088::next( unsigned long& s1, unsigned long& s2, unsigned long& s3 )

00387 inline double Ran088::nextDouble( unsigned long& s1, unsigned long& s2, unsigned long& s3 )
00388 {
